Let \(K=\mathbb Q\), \(p=3\), \(v=3\), and \[A=\mathbb Q_3[\epsilon]/(\epsilon^3)\] with trivial \(G_\mathbb Q\)-action. Let \(E/\mathbb Q\) be the elliptic curve \(y^2=x^3-x\), let \(B=H^1_{\mathrm{\acute et}}(E_{\overline\mathbb Q},\mathbb Q_3)\), and put \[V=A\otimes_{\mathbb Q_3}B,\qquad
L=A\otimes_{\mathbb Q_3}\mathbb Q_3(-1).\] The cup-product pairing on \(B\) extends to a perfect alternating \(A\)-bilinear, \(G_\mathbb Q\)-equivariant pairing \(V\times V\to L\). Here \(V\) is free of rank \(2\) over \(A\), so \(d=1\), and \(L\) is free of rank one. The actions are continuous and compatible with all structures.
